name: Glazed Chicken Stir-Fry with Sesame Broccoli-Bell Pepper Slaw & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup rice vinegar
toasted sesame oil
chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper. Halve crosswise, then slice into thin strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw. Toss to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium carrots
1 (340 g) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with cold water (from the tap) and cornstarch. Whisk to combine.
Add ketchup, soy sauce, honey, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the cornstarch mixture. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
2 tbsp honey
chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir-fry until chicken is just cooked through, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, add the stir-fry sauce, and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, dressed slaw, and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
